Farewell

📍 Singapore, Singapore 📅 August 25, 2025 📖 1 min read
Tags: Travel
Contents

Morning

Capitoline Museums

This marks the final day of my “vacation”. The final location I decided to visit was the Capitoline Museums, which I did because the timing matches. There was a giant statue, but I was suprised by the stairs leading elsewhere to a similalr building.

Evening

How do I feel as I board the plane? Nervous to be honest, so far I have been living as a tourist. Now I am expected to see how my next few months look like, through due to daylight savings it wasn’t dark until I finally arrived. In fact a nice Spanish man helped me to contact the guy in the flat to give me my keys.

Overall I felt a renewed sense of independence with this trip, I have always thought that Europe is for the rich people, and is something that I dream of. Before this, I have never thought that it is possible. I felt…alive, like this trip has exposed to me what I can see.
